WATERTOWN, Mass., Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[CAMP4 Therapeutics Corporation](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=GNurzdRp2D6FZ8hpjsnvW2M00TP_F1ZEr9xRbEuo_qpuxxgtNER4LI5WIfj5bYA0bYjCXGC95nbqwPlGNmiLljUHPqzYzpotYXrLWG7flOyRVHxclA3dx0cNdRusassXQHnGLivAPGCju-japG9hFaFQZtUZI0DzzPtDQNPHY4vcNjS6Yf2oECeauKQCZf9YB1KexggbSFnf-p1KTD2GR-zPAmD0Xf9pzO_csU80DGLdd1G690xpTZNHJWuRyB2vAG0sHG98u-spjqqhGfLfoAGWoiwmpZ0Vi7f8k2_ySZ6XTyoXfIZiTduysjk_0Unu) (“CAMP4” or “the Company”) (Nasdaq: CAMP), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a pipeline of regulatory RNA-targeting therapeutics designed to upregulate gene expression with the goal of restoring healthy protein levels to treat a broad range of genetic diseases, today announced that the Company will participate in the following upcoming investor conferences:

**Cantor Global Healthcare Conference**

Webcast Link:[Click Here](https://investors.camp4tx.com/news-events/events)


Live webcasts can be accessed on the investor relations page of CAMP4’s website at[https://investors.camp4tx.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=iDrwRfJ2aK1cani5OdedWsX5nSYs2JjDDwMFTRptsqYIluFzKTdBATJ0UoDanPqUW2EFoe4ZoxaVwQhdrqkjCfI0aZPoP8lsItu94eFeaMODyWfFiVBpbhxa3qcCIqg1) . A replay of the webcast will be archived on the CAMP4 website for 30 days following the presentation.


**About CAMP4 Therapeutics**
CAMP4 is developing disease-modifying treatments for a broad range of genetic diseases where amplifying healthy protein may offer therapeutic benefits. Our approach amplifies mRNA by harnessing a fundamental mechanism of how genes are controlled. To amplify mRNA, our therapeutic ASO drug candidates target regulatory RNAs (regRNAs), which act locally on transcription factors and are the master regulators of gene expression. CAMP4's proprietary RAP Platform® enables the mapping of regRNAs and generation of therapeutic candidates designed to target the regRNAs associated with genes underlying haploinsufficient and recessive partial loss-of-function disorders, of which there are more than 1,200, in which a modest increase in protein expression may have the potential to be clinically meaningful. For more information, visit camp4tx.com.
